points.description: States that backpropagation reduces/minimises the error (loss) of a multi-layer network (MLP) by propagating the error backwards from the output (last) layer to the first layer, layer by layer, updating the weights. Equivalent wording accepted.

Explains that the weight updates are determined by the local gradient at each layer, computed using partial derivatives of the error with respect to the weights and the chain rule. Equivalent wording accepted (e.g. gradient descent using chain rule derivatives).
